Ali Alipour.note: Watch Alipour for waiting for a defender's attention to shift before moving. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Ali Alipour.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是等防守者注意力转移后再启动。留意他如何接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Ali Nemati.summary: Ali Nemati is an IR Iran centre-back from Foolad FC who gives the national team left-footed defending, aerial cover, and back-line depth.
Ali Nemati.note: Nemati's edge is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Ali Nemati.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Alireza Beiranvand.note: Beiranvand is defined by organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step.
Alireza Beiranvand.noteZh: 他靠在危险出现前组织好队友与同位置球员拉开差异。他会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。他也会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。

Alireza Jahanbakhsh.note: Jahanbakhsh's edge is calm decisions shaped by experience in high-pressure moments. He varies the height and pace of his delivery. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Alireza Jahanbakhsh.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是高压时刻由经验带来的冷静判断。他会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Amirhossein Hosseinzadeh.summary: Amirhossein Hosseinzadeh is an IR Iran forward from Tractor FC who gives the national team quick turns, final-third carrying, and attacking spark.
Amirhossein Hosseinzadeh.note: Hosseinzadeh's edge is making purposeful movement away from the ball. He opens his body on the first touch so he can play forward. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Amirhossein Hosseinzadeh.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是用有目的的无球移动创造接应点。他会第一脚触球时打开身体，准备向前处理。他也会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Amirmohammad Razaghinia.summary: Amirmohammad Razzaghinia is an IR Iran central midfielder from Esteghlal FC who gives the national team midfield legs, duel pressure, and simple progression.
Amirmohammad Razaghinia.note: Razzaghinia's signature is creating a better angle for the next pass. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Amirmohammad Razaghinia.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在为下一脚传球制造更好的角度上。他会等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Arya Yousefi.summary: Arya Yousefi is an IR Iran right-back from Sepahan FC who gives the national team overlap timing, recovery defending, and right-side energy.
Arya Yousefi.note: Yousefi's edge is pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Arya Yousefi.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Danial Iri.summary: Danial Eiri is an IR Iran centre-back from Malavan Bandar Anzali who gives the national team centre-back depth, aerial defending, and box protection.
Danial Iri.note: Eiri stands out for the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Danial Iri.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Dennis Dargahi.note: Ayensa stands out for pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Dennis Dargahi.noteZh: 他的突出特点是带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑。他会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。他也会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Ehsan Hajisafi.note: Hajsafi's signature is calm decisions shaped by experience in high-pressure moments. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Ehsan Hajisafi.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在高压时刻由经验带来的冷静判断上。他会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Hossein Hosseini.note: Hosseini's edge is staying ready through long quiet spells. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
Hossein Hosseini.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在长时间无事可做后依然保持专注。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Hossein Kanani.note: Watch Kanaanizadegan for choosing the moment of contact instead of diving in. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions.
Hossein Kanani.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是选择身体接触时机，而不是贸然上抢。留意他如何主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。

Mehdi Ghayedi.summary: Mehdi Ghayedi is an IR Iran winger from Al-Nasr SC who gives the national team low-centre turns, inside shots, and left-wing dribbling.
Mehdi Ghayedi.note: Ghayedi stands out for changing direction without losing control of the ball. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target. He opens his body on the first touch so he can play forward.
Mehdi Ghayedi.noteZh: 他的突出特点是变向时仍把球控制在脚下。他会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。他也会第一脚触球时打开身体，准备向前处理。

Mehdi Taremi.note: Taremi's edge is making purposeful movement away from the ball. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path.
Mehdi Taremi.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是用有目的的无球移动创造接应点。他会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。他也会用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。

Mehdi Torabi.note: Watch Torabi for delivering the ball without needing much space. He varies the height and pace of his delivery. He changes pace after the defender has committed his feet.
Mehdi Torabi.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在很小空间里也能送出传中的能力。留意他如何通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。他也会等防守者脚步固定后突然变速。

Milad Mohammadi.note: Mohammadi is defined by recovery speed when the defensive line is exposed. He turns early and protects the route toward goal. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him.
Milad Mohammadi.noteZh: 他靠防线暴露后的回追速度与同位置球员拉开差异。他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。他也会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。

Mohammad Ghorbani.summary: Mohammad Ghorbani is an IR Iran defensive midfielder from Al-Wahda FC who gives the national team central coverage, ball winning, and midfield size.
Mohammad Ghorbani.note: Watch Ghorbani for creating a better angle for the next pass. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. He holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives.
Mohammad Ghorbani.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是为下一脚传球制造更好的角度。留意他如何等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。他也会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Mohammad Mohebbi.note: Mohebi is defined by creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He changes his position early enough to give the passer a clear target. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Mohammad Mohebbi.noteZh: 他靠在防线重组前制造干净射门与同位置球员拉开差异。他会提前改变位置，为传球队友提供清晰目标。他也会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Payam Niazmand.note: Niazmand is defined by sharp reactions backed by early positioning. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders. He chooses the simple restart before pressure can close in.
Payam Niazmand.noteZh: 他靠提前站位后的快速反应与同位置球员拉开差异。他会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。他也会在逼抢靠近前选择最稳妥的出球方式。

Ramin Rezaeian.note: Rezaeian stands out for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area.
Ramin Rezaeian.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。

Roozbeh Cheshmi.note: Cheshmi's signature is creating a better angle for the next pass. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives.
Roozbeh Cheshmi.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在为下一脚传球制造更好的角度上。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Saeid Ezatolahi.note: Ezatolahi stands out for keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Saeid Ezatolahi.noteZh: 他的突出特点是压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Saleh Hardani.note: Hardani's signature is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose.
Saleh Hardani.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢上。他会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。他也会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。

Saman Ghoddos.note: Ghoddos is defined by seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He varies the height and pace of his delivery. He opens his body on the first touch so he can play forward.
Saman Ghoddos.noteZh: 他靠比防线早一步看到决定性的传球与同位置球员拉开差异。他会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。他也会第一脚触球时打开身体，准备向前处理。

Shahriyar Moghanloo.note: Moghanlou stands out for making purposeful movement away from the ball. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift. He pins a defender and creates room for the next runner.
Shahriyar Moghanloo.noteZh: 他的突出特点是用有目的的无球移动创造接应点。他会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。他也会牵制一名后卫，为后插上的队友腾出空间。

Shoja Khalilzadeh.note: Khalilzadeh is defined by calm decisions shaped by experience in high-pressure moments. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions.
Shoja Khalilzadeh.noteZh: 他靠高压时刻由经验带来的冷静判断与同位置球员拉开差异。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。
